meta.title: VIETNAM Vlog | 6D5N Hanoi to Sapa | DIY Itinerary Guide & Tips | Episode 5
meta.description:
Welcome to the last episode (Episode 5) of our Vietnam Travel Series! 🇻🇳❤️

📅 Travel Dates: March 23–28, 2026
Join us as we travel from Sapa to Hanoi during our 6-day Vietnam trip, sharing our actual experiences to help you plan your own Vietnam adventure.✨

In this episode:
🍜 Hong Lien Bun Cha
⛪ St. Joseph’s Cathedral
🍫 Discovering local Vietnamese Chocolate
🛍️ Pasalubong Shopping
🏬 Lotte Mart
🎁 Ate Ha Souvenir Shop
☕ Cafe Giang with Friends
✈️ Back to Manila 🇵🇭

And just like that, our Vietnam series comes to an end!❤️

Thank you so much for watching and being part of our journey. We're happy to share our experiences, travel guides, and tips with you. 🫶

Hope our videos inspire your next adventure! See you in our next series! ✈️🌏
